instruction: 创建一个带有条件渲染的按钮
input: 根据条件显示不同的按钮状态
output:
<template>
  <LSButton 
    v-if="isLoading" 
    type="primary" 
    :loading="true">
    加载中...
  </LSButton>
  <LSButton 
    v-else 
    type="primary" 
    @click="handleSubmit">
    提交
  </LSButton>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';

const isLoading = ref(false);

const handleSubmit = async () => {
  isLoading.value = true;
  // 模拟异步操作
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
  isLoading.value = false;
};
</script>
// 说明：根据条件(isLoading)动态切换按钮状态，实现加载状态和正常状态的切换
